title: IntraSlice: Towards High-Performance Structural Pruning with Block-Intra PCA for LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a structural pruning method (IntraSlice) for LLMs using PCA. The evaluations are conducted on standard language understanding and reasoning benchmarks (e.g., ARC, BoolQ, HellaSwag) and do not involve religion, ethics, or moral values.
